subject: history
concept: Understanding basic symbols and traditions of one's own country (flag, anthem, key national symbols)
source_inspiration: original content — not sourced from any external text

exercise.concrete: Student examines their country's flag and identifies its colors/symbols
exercise.pictorial: Student matches a national symbol to what it represents
exercise.abstract: Student explains what a described national symbol represents

misconception_flags: confuses their own country's symbols with another country's

interest_binding: exercise regenerated using student's stated interest profile
